title: Venezuela M7.5 doublet: infrastructure exposure

event.summary: Doublet: M7.2 (USGS early: 7.1) then M7.5 about 39 s later, 10 km deep. Disasters Charter: strongest to hit Venezuela in over a century.

facts: Main shock M7.5 on 2026-06-24, about 22:05 UTC
EMSC location 10.445, -68.378, depth 10 km
Preceded by an M7.2 (USGS early figure 7.1) about 39 seconds earlier
Death toll is contested across sources (4,118 cited by one aggregator; Wikipedia list total differs): must not be asserted as a single tool-derived number

must_do: State that get_earthquakes covers only the last 24 hours, so the epicenter comes from the prompt or an external archive, not the live tool
Use a lat/lon + radius_km area at the epicenter rather than the place name 'Morón'
List infrastructure with distances and name each source dataset (OSM, TeleGeography)
must_not: Claim the live earthquake feed returned this event
Resolve 'Morón' to Morón in Argentina or Cuba

title: Bhote Koshi flood reconstruction

event.summary: Flash flood from the Tibet side of the border swept the Bhote Koshi valley, affecting six districts in Bagmati and Gandaki provinces and damaging roads, bridges and hydropower.

facts: Flood on 2026-08-26 in the Bhote Koshi, Rasuwa district
Water came from the Tibet (China) side of the border
A Nepal health-sector report links it to an ice and rock avalanche that temporarily dammed the Lhende Khola; the trigger was not scientifically confirmed
Damage to roads, bridges and hydropower facilities (Nepal MoFA)
